name: Japandi
tagline: Calm, natural, fewer but better things
tips: Pick two or three natural materials (light wood, linen, ceramic) and repeat them through the room.
Keep surfaces mostly empty so each object has room to breathe.
Use warm, low lighting such as a paper lantern instead of a bright overhead light.

name: Modern Minimalist
tagline: Clean lines, open space, clear order
tips: Stick to a white and gray base and add a single bold accent color.
Hide clutter in closed storage so every surface stays clear.
Choose furniture with straight lines and no decoration.

name: Boho
tips: Layer two or three rugs and add pillows in earthy, mixed patterns.
Fill corners with plants at different heights.
Mix woven textures such as rattan, macramé and jute.

name: Scandinavian
tips: Use white walls and light wood floors to bounce daylight around the room.
Add warmth with a chunky wool throw and a few candles.
Keep frames thin and artwork simple.

name: Classic / Vintage
tips: Go deep with burgundy and green, then add gold accents.
Hang a large mirror or an oil painting as the focal point.
Mix one antique piece with newer ones so the room feels collected.

name: Industrial
tips: Show raw materials: brick, concrete, steel and aged wood.
Use exposed-bulb fixtures and black metal frames.
Add a worn leather piece to soften the hard edges.
